title: 2023 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Greta Grasshopper sits on a long line of lily pads in a pond. From any lily pad, Greta can jump \(5\) pads to the right or \(3\) pads to the left. What is the fewest number of jumps Greta must make to reach the lily pad located \(2023\) pads to the right of her starting position?

solutions.text:
Let \(r\) be the number of right jumps and \(l\) be the number of left jumps. We need \[ 5r-3l=2023. \] Reducing modulo \(5\) gives \(-3l\equiv3\pmod5\), so \(l\equiv4\pmod5\).

To minimize the total number of jumps, use the smallest possible \(l\), namely \(l=4\). Then \(5r-12=2023\), so \(r=407\).

The fewest number of jumps is \(407+4=411\).

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Start with \(404\) jumps to the right, which reaches \(2020\)
The extra jumps must have net displacement \(3\)
